Resubmission mode
Resubmission — selected UDI-DIs only

Paste UDI-DI codes (one per line or comma-separated). Only those devices will be generated.

Basic UDIs already in EUDAMED
Already-created Basic UDIs

Paste Basic UDI-DI codes (BUDI_DICode, one per line or comma-separated) that EUDAMED already accepted in a prior upload. Every row of these families is generated as UDI_DI.POST only — never DEVICE.POST again, since EUDAMED lets a Basic UDI be created exactly once.
